Are you the real hero? 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♀️
A battlegrounds experience.  The game is in Beta, please be patient as we improve and fix bugs! 🐛

🖥️ Controls
G - Activate Ultimate 
F - Block
Q - Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - ragdoll cancel/evasive
Double Tap W - run
Left Click - Punch
B - Emote Wheel
1,2,3,4 - Character Abilities
